overview_description.description:
SendHub is the Phone System for the Mobile World. There's no hardware, setup is instant and it scales elastically with a single click. Users are given a phone number in any area code, they can use from any device: Web, iPhone, Android, Feature Phones and via our API.

Businesses can add lines for everyone on their team for free, with complete transparency and powerful analytics on every aspect of your telecommunication.

Additional Features: 
Auto Attendant, 
Call Transfer, 
Company Directory, 
Contact Sharing, 
Voicemail Transcription, 
Text Marketing & Group Texting, 
Free Internal Communication.

product.name: Business SMS and MMS Messaging Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform enabling businesses to send and receive SMS and MMS messages for communication, marketing, and customer engagement.

product.name: SendHub SMS API
product.description: An API that allows developers to integrate SendHub’s SMS and MMS messaging capabilities into their own software and CRM systems.

product.name: SendHub Mobile iOS App
product.description: A mobile application for iOS devices that allows users to send, receive, and manage business SMS and MMS messages on the go.

identifier.value: SendHub Online Messaging Inbox and Dashboard

product.name: SendHub Online Messaging Inbox and Dashboard
product.description: A web-based interface that organizes and displays all inbound and outbound SMS and MMS messages for easy management and tracking.

product.name: SendHub Contact Database Management
product.description: A feature that allows businesses to upload, edit, and organize contacts and groups to streamline SMS marketing and communication.

product.name: SendHub Analytics and Reporting
product.description: Tools that provide insights, graphs, and downloadable data to analyze SMS and MMS message performance and engagement.
